shortDescription: Collect network statistics using the AIX netstat command

options.name: address_family
options.description: Limit reports to a specific address family using C(-f).

options.name: all_sockets_state
options.description: Display the state of all sockets using C(-a).

options.name: cache_stats
options.description: Display network buffer cache statistics using C(-c).

options.name: clear_stats
options.description: Clear statistics using C(-Z). C(c) clears network buffer statistics. C(i) clears interface statistics. C(m) clears memory allocator statistics. C(s) clears protocol statistics.

options.name: concatenated_output
options.description: If true, append output to file; if false, overwrite file.

options.name: concise_protocol_stats
options.description: Display only non-zero protocol statistics using C(-ss).

options.name: count
options.description: Number of samples to collect along with interval.

options.name: display_adapter_statistics
options.description: Display adapter statistics for CDLI adapters using C(-v).

options.name: display_configured_interfaces
options.description: Display all configured interfaces using C(-i).

options.name: domain_sockets
options.description: Display information about domain sockets using C(-u).

options.name: interactive_mode
options.description: Start interactive mode using C(-w).

options.name: interface_name
options.description: Display information for a specific interface using C(-I <interface>).

options.name: interval
options.description: Time in seconds between repeated netstat samples.

options.name: mbuf_pool_stats
options.description: Display mbuf cluster pool statistics using C(-M).

options.name: memory_stats
options.description: Display memory management statistics using C(-m).

options.name: numeric_network_address
options.description: Display network addresses numerically using C(-n). When omitted, symbolic hostnames may appear.

options.name: packet_counts
options.description: Show communications subsystem packet counts using C(-D).

options.name: pcb_address
options.description: Show protocol control block (PCB) addresses using C(-A).

options.name: protocol
options.description: Display statistics for the given protocol using C(-p).

options.name: protocol_stats
options.description: Display protocol statistics using C(-s).

options.name: ras_artifacts
options.description: Display reliability, availability, and serviceability (RAS) artifacts using C(-K <protocol>).

options.name: ras_file
options.description: File path to store RAS output when using C(-F).

options.name: ras_suppress_nonzero
options.description: Suppress non-zero counters in RAS output using C(-b).

options.name: recorded_output
options.description: File path to record command output.

options.name: routing_table
options.description: Display routing tables using C(-r).

options.name: show_route_details
options.description: Display routing details including metrics and policy information using C(-C).

options.name: socket_options
options.description: Show detailed socket options along with C(-a) using C(-o).

options.name: virtual_interface_and_multicast
options.description: Display virtual interface table and multicast forwarding cache using C(-g).
